items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Marie Cole and I went down to see him

ctx.x: And Rose was talking about when he was in the hospital here in 1973, at St. Vincent's -- and what happened, Rose?
He called here; or had the nurse call, and asked me -- Marie Cole and I went down to see him, and

then he called back again, and asked me would I bring him some cornbread, because he couldn't get cornbread there, so Juan and I went to see him to give him the cornbread, and then when he left the hospital and went to the Beverly Wilshire Hotel to live, he called and asked me would I make him a beef stew and make him some cornbread and bring it out there, so naturally, I made the beef stew and I made the cornbread and I took it out there to him, and I said, 'Well, I think I will have some of your beef stew and…
